status.description: Read-only. Find the retail.sc.com tab and report its path and whether it is logged in (login page is /sg/nfs/login.htm). Never reports the query string, which carries the session token.

estatements.description: Read-only. On the eStatements page (estatement_list_summary.htm), list the statement rows and their View PDF anchors. If the tab is on another ibank page it first clicks the eStatements menu anchor in-page (never Page.navigate, which drops the session). With dest, fetch each PDF with an in-page fetch (credentials included), return base64 to node, and write <type>-<month>.pdf into dest. No transfers, no form submits.

dest.description: directory to write PDFs into (created if missing); omit to only list

returns.description: {count, rows:[{anchorIndex, selectIndex, documentType, type, month, cells, rowText}]} without dest; {count, files:[{path, bytes, isPdf}|{type, month, error}]} with dest; {stop:"not-logged-in"|"menu-link-not-found"|"page-not-reached"|"no-pdf-links", hint} otherwise; {state:"no-tab", hint} if no tab is open
